choose.label: Choose
choose.description: Chooses what to do based on conditions (Similar to If-then, but more powerful).

repeat_count.label: Repeat multiple times
repeat_count.description: Repeats a sequence of actions a fixed number of times.

repeat_while.label: Repeat while
repeat_while.description: Repeats a sequence of actions as long as a condition is satisfied. The condition is checked before each run of the sequence.

repeat_until.label: Repeat until
repeat_until.description: Repeats a sequence of actions until a condition is satisfied. The condition is checked after each run of the sequence.

repeat_for_each.label: Repeat for each
repeat_for_each.description: Repeats a sequence for each element of a list.

wait_for.label: Wait for…
wait_for.description: Pauses the automation — for a trigger to fire, a template to become true, or simply a fixed amount of time.

set_variables.label: Define variables
set_variables.description: Defines variables to be used later in the sequence.

test_condition.label: Condition
test_condition.description: Tests a condition (and stops the sequence if the condition is not met).

fire_event.label: Fire manual event
fire_event.description: Fires an event manually (events are a building block used across Home Assistant).

sequence.label: Run in sequence
sequence.description: Runs a group of actions in sequence.

panel.selectNode: Select a node to edit its properties

native.targetDescription: Watch a specific entity, every entity on a device, in an area, on a floor, or sharing a label.
native.behaviorDescription: How the trigger fires when it's watching more than one target.
native.thresholdDescription: Brightness percentage the trigger watches for.
native.thresholdForDescription: How long the value must continuously meet the threshold before the trigger fires.

enumFieldDescriptions.hvacMode: HVAC mode(s) to watch for — only the modes the targeted device supports are valid; check your device for exact values.
enumFieldDescriptions.mode: Mode(s) to watch for — only the modes the targeted device supports are valid; check your device for exact values. Leave empty to fire on any mode change.
enumFieldDescriptions.operationMode: Operation mode(s) to watch for — only the modes the targeted water heater supports are valid; check your device for exact values.
enumFieldDescriptions.zone: The zone to watch, e.g. zone.home.
enumFieldDescriptions.eventType: Event type(s) to watch for — the targeted event entity lists the types it can fire.

native.durationFieldDescription: The amount of time remaining on the timer that should fire this trigger.
native.offsetDescription: How long before or after the event this trigger fires.
native.offsetDescriptionRequired: How long before or after the event this trigger fires. Required — set to 0 to fire exactly at the event.
native.offsetTypeDescription: Whether the offset applies before or after the event.

stateTransition.negatedDescription: Cannot combine with the positive state — switching clears it.

picker.selectType: Select a type above to see its triggers

platformDescriptions.state: Triggers when an entity's state changes.
platformDescriptions.numeric_state: Triggers when an entity's numeric state crosses a threshold.
platformDescriptions.time: Triggers at a specific time of day.
platformDescriptions.time_pattern: Triggers periodically, matching a pattern of hours, minutes, or seconds.
platformDescriptions.sun: Triggers at sunrise or sunset, with an optional offset.
platformDescriptions.event: Triggers when a specific Home Assistant event fires.
platformDescriptions.mqtt: Triggers when a message is published to an MQTT topic.
platformDescriptions.webhook: Triggers when a webhook receives a request.
platformDescriptions.zone: Triggers when a person enters or leaves a zone.
platformDescriptions.template: Triggers when a Jinja2 template's result becomes true.
platformDescriptions.homeassistant: Triggers when Home Assistant starts up or shuts down.
platformDescriptions.device: Triggers using a device-specific trigger from a chosen device.
platformDescriptions.calendar: Triggers when a calendar event starts or ends.
platformDescriptions.tag: Triggers when an NFC tag is scanned.
platformDescriptions.geo_location: Triggers when an entity from a geolocation platform enters or leaves a zone.
platformDescriptions.conversation: Triggers when Assist matches a spoken or typed sentence.
platformDescriptions.persistent_notification: Triggers when a persistent notification is added, removed, updated, or current.

native.behaviorDescription: How the condition evaluates when it's watching more than one target.
native.behaviorAnyDescription: Is true if any target matches the desired state
native.behaviorAllDescription: Is true if all targets match the desired state
native.thresholdDescription: The value this condition checks has to meet or exceed this threshold to pass.

enumFieldDescriptions.hvacMode: HVAC mode(s) to match — only the modes the targeted device supports are valid; check your device for exact values.
enumFieldDescriptions.mode: Mode(s) to match — only the modes the targeted device supports are valid; check your device for exact values.
enumFieldDescriptions.operationMode: Operation mode(s) to match — only the modes the targeted water heater supports are valid; check your device for exact values.
enumFieldDescriptions.option: Option(s) to match — the targeted select's own options.
enumFieldDescriptions.zone: The zone(s) to test, e.g. zone.home.

native.singleValueDescription: The exact text value to match.
native.bareBooleanNotice: "{{conditionType}}" is a simple yes/no check with nothing else to configure — it passes or fails entirely on its own, so this panel is expected to be empty below.

waitFor.triggerDescription: Waits for a trigger to perform a sequence of actions.
waitFor.templateDescription: Waits for a template to be evaluated to true to perform a sequence of actions.
waitFor.delayDescription: Waits some time before continuing the sequence of actions.
waitFor.automationOn: Wait for an automation to turn on
waitFor.automationOnDescription: Pauses until a chosen automation is enabled (turned on).
waitFor.automationOff: Wait for an automation to turn off
waitFor.automationOffDescription: Pauses until a chosen automation is disabled (turned off). Note: this reflects enabled/disabled, not whether the automation is currently running — Home Assistant has no built-in signal for that.
waitFor.script: Wait for a script to finish
waitFor.scriptDescription: Pauses until a chosen script stops running.

actions.repeatCountDescription: How many times the sequence runs
actions.continueOnErrorDescription: If this step fails, keep running the rest of the sequence instead of halting the automation or script.
actions.opaqueStepPanelDescription: Circuitry can't edit this kind of step, so it is saved exactly as written. Change it in Home Assistant's YAML editor, or delete it here.

durationField.label: Duration
durationField.description: Specify duration in hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds

responseVariableField.label: Response Variable
responseVariableField.optionalDescription: This action can return a response. Enable to use the response and enter the name of a variable the response will be saved in.
responseVariableField.requiredDescription: This action returns a response. Enter the name of a variable the response will be saved in.
responseVariableField.manualDescription: Enable to store this step's response data in a variable — for a service call, enter the name of a variable the response will be saved in; for Stop, enter the name of an existing variable whose data should be returned.
responseVariableField.currentNodeWarning: '{{name}}' is reserved for the state-machine strategy. Using this name may cause unexpected behavior.

setVariablesFields.empty: No variables defined. Click the button below to add one.
setVariablesFields.name: Name

startFields.empty: No input fields defined. Anyone calling this flow can still trigger it — add a field if it needs to accept a value.
startFields.name: Name
startFields.descriptionPlaceholder: Shown to whoever calls this flow

optionAllDescription.unconnected: Carry on once every path coming in has finished.
optionAllDescription.two: Carry on once both paths coming in have finished.
optionAllDescription.many: Carry on once all {{count}} paths coming in have finished.

joinFields.optionAnyDescription: Carry on as soon as the first one finishes.
joinFields.runsToEnd: Every path always runs to the end. Home Assistant can't stop one part-way.

wait.waitTemplateDescription: Template condition that must be true to continue
wait.timeoutDescription: Off: wait as long as it takes. On: give up after the time below.
wait.continueOnTimeoutDescription: If enabled, the automation continues when timeout expires. If disabled, the automation stops.

fieldDescriptions.to: The target state to trigger on
fieldDescriptions.from: Only trigger when transitioning from this state
fieldDescriptions.for: Must be stable for this duration
fieldDescriptions.above: Trigger when value goes above this threshold
fieldDescriptions.below: Trigger when value goes below this threshold
fieldDescriptions.at: Time to trigger (HH:MM:SS or entity reference)
fieldDescriptions.event_type: The type of event to listen for
fieldDescriptions.event_data: Filter events by data fields (JSON object)
fieldDescriptions.payload: Only trigger on this specific payload
fieldDescriptions.event: The event that activates the trigger
fieldDescriptions.offset: Time offset before (-) or after (+) the event
fieldDescriptions.after: Condition is true after this time
fieldDescriptions.before: Condition is true before this time
fieldDescriptions.weekday: Days of the week when condition is true
fieldDescriptions.after_offset: Time offset for the after event
fieldDescriptions.before_offset: Time offset for the before event
fieldDescriptions.state: The state value to check for
fieldDescriptions.attribute: Check a specific attribute instead of the state
fieldDescriptions.id: The ID(s) of the trigger(s) to match
fieldDescriptions.match: Whether every selected entity must match, or just one
fieldDescriptions.not_from: Trigger unless transitioning from this state — cannot combine with From State
fieldDescriptions.not_to: Trigger unless transitioning to this state — cannot combine with To State
fieldDescriptions.allowed_methods: HTTP methods that may call this webhook — defaults to POST and PUT
fieldDescriptions.local_only: Restrict this webhook to devices on the same network as Home Assistant
fieldDescriptions.encoding: Payload decoding — defaults to 'utf-8'; use an empty value for binary payloads
fieldDescriptions.tag_id: The scanned tag ID(s) to match
fieldDescriptions.source: The geo_location platform providing the entity
fieldDescriptions.notification_id: Limit to a specific notification — otherwise triggers for any notification ID
fieldDescriptions.update_type: Limit to these update types — otherwise triggers for all of them
fieldDescriptions.command: Sentence template(s) to match, spoken to Assist
fieldDescriptions.variables: Values available as trigger.* in templates when this trigger fires
fieldDescriptions.fire_event_data: Custom data sent with the event — accessible as trigger.event.data.* by anything listening for it
fieldDescriptions.for_each_items: The items to loop over — plain values, or objects (dicts) usable in the sequence as repeat.item.<key>
fieldDescriptions.for_each_template: A Jinja2 template that evaluates to a list of items to loop over

conventions.andHint: Chained to the condition before it: if this one fails, that condition's else runs.
conventions.stopsHereHint: Nothing is connected here, so the automation stops at this point.

gaps.forEach: Add the items to repeat for

pill.editConditionState: Change the state it must be in
pill.notActedOn: Home Assistant ignores this entity here

hints.each: Every one that changes fires it.
hints.first: Only the first: when none of them was like that yet.
hints.last: Only the last: when all of them are like that.
hints.any: Any one that changes fires it.
hints.all: When all of them are like that.

more.triggerNameHint: So an And step can tell which trigger started the automation.
more.carryOnHint: The steps after it still run.
more.attributeHint: Brightness, colour mode… instead of its state.

template.hint: Fires when this turns from false to true.

mqtt.payloadHint: Empty: any message on the topic.

webhook.hint: Called at /api/webhook/ followed by this ID.
